resources.string: Speak to Third Eye. Double tap, then say what you need.
Note reader is on. Hold a rupee note in front of the camera. Press back to stop.
Sorry, the note reader model is missing from this version of the app, so I can\'t read notes yet.
Take photo and read the text
Opening the text reader for %1$s. Hold the page in front of the camera, then press the big yellow button at the bottom to take a photo.
Looking for Sinhala and Tamil text. This takes a few seconds.
Reading in Sinhala. This takes a few seconds.
Reading in Tamil. This takes a few seconds.

This text is in %1$s, but this phone has no %1$s voice, so I can\'t read it aloud. The text is shown on the screen. To add a voice, open Settings, then Text-to-speech, open the speech engine\'s settings, and install %1$s voice data.
I\'m not sure about this reading, so some words may be wrong.
I\'m fairly sure of this reading.
The %1$s reading files are not on this phone, so I can\'t read %1$s yet. Please ask the person who set up the app to add them.
Nothing is recognised. Tap the bottom of your screen to try again.
Text recognition failed. Tap the bottom of your screen to try again.
Tap the bottom of your screen to check again.
Okay, I\'ll listen for English now.
හරි, දැන් සිංහලෙන් කතා කරන්න. Okay, I\'ll listen for Sinhala now.
சரி, இனி தமிழில் பேசுங்கள். Okay, I\'ll listen for Tamil now.
This phone has no %1$s voice, so I\'ll keep speaking English. To add one, open Settings, then Text-to-speech, then Install voice data.
Speech recognition isn\'t available on this phone right now. Connect to the internet, install the Google app, or add the offline listening model.
No internet, so I\'m listening on the phone. Speak after the beep.
Offline listening understands English only, not %1$s.
Say torch on, or torch off.
